description:
The mornings of the last days the brief would have given, each as it would be planned: the edition's lines,
then each lane's own, every line a happening with our title and page, its main at the world and why it is
there; a quiet lane says so, and so does one whose stories found no room. From the pool alone; nothing is saved.

brief.description: The brief: the record in YAML or JSON (the schema at /start/brief.schema.json, the example at /start/brief.example.yaml); a plain name where no id is known is resolved.
